exceptions.reachability: ESLint and shadcn execute during development/build. shadcn remains in dependencies as before, but the application imports only its static Tailwind CSS, not its JavaScript CLI in request handlers. Glob patterns come from repository-controlled files/configuration; HTTP input is never passed to braces. No patched braces release is available. Do not run these tools with untrusted patterns or registries; review upstream before this exception expires.

Used by Prisma CLI configuration loaded from repository-controlled files. Go-Trail request handlers do not import prisma/config or merge attacker-controlled recursive object graphs. A fix is available through Prisma 7.10.1, but the user explicitly deferred this coordinated dependency upgrade until open PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. Keep this exception time-bounded and do not load untrusted Prisma config.

MySQL driver bundled by Prisma CLI. Go-Trail uses PostgreSQL via the pg adapter and does not open MySQL connections or use mysql_clear_password. A patch is available through Prisma 7.10.1; the user deferred the upgrade until current PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. This exception must be reviewed before enabling any MySQL path and before expiry.

Affected path requires a compressed MySQL connection to a malicious or compromised MySQL server. Go-Trail uses PostgreSQL via pg and does not enable the MySQL compressed protocol. A patch is available through Prisma 7.10.1; the user deferred the coordinated upgrade until open PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. Review before any MySQL use or exception expiry.
